title: How Robust Are Router-LLMs? Analysis of the Fragility of LLM Routing Capabilities
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the robustness and safety of LLM routers across categories like math, coding, and jailbreaking. While it incorporates safety benchmarks (AdvBench) to assess the risk of routing harmful queries to weaker models, it does not evaluate religious topics, moral reasoning, or specific ethical frameworks.
